messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Saturday 8 Feb, 20:00-23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The DMS and CE-File integration will be unavailable this Saturday 8 February between 20:00 and 23:00 for scheduled maintenance. Please save and close any open documents before 20:00. Email will be unaffected.

If you have an urgent filing deadline over the weekend, contact the helpdesk in advance.

IT Helpdesk
